mapper.select: select coil_id as coilId, coil_no as coilNo, label_no as labelNo, order_no as orderNo, customer_name as customerName, material_code as materialCode, product_name as productName, material, spec, hardness, surface_ra as surfaceRa, net_weight as netWeight, pieces, produce_date as produceDate, checker, location, in_date as inDate, coil_status as coilStatus, remark from inv_finish_coil where coil_no = #{coilNo} limit 1

select order_id as orderId, order_no as orderNo, order_date as orderDate, customer_name as customerName, contact_person as contactPerson, contact_phone as contactPhone, contact_address as contactAddress, material_code as materialCode, product_name as productName, material, spec, hardness, tensile_strength as tensileStrength, unit, quantity, unit_price as unitPrice, amount, delivery_date as deliveryDate, remark from ord_sale_order where order_no = #{orderNo} order by order_id

select r.record_id as recordId, r.work_order_id as workOrderId, r.work_order_no as workOrderNo, r.process_no as processNo, r.process_name as processName, r.machine as machine, r.operator as operator, r.start_time as startTime, r.end_time as endTime, r.input_weight as inputWeight, r.output_weight as outputWeight, r.loss_weight as lossWeight, r.remark as remark from prod_process_record r left join prod_work_order w on w.work_order_no = r.work_order_no where w.order_no = #{orderNo} order by r.work_order_no, r.process_no

select inspection_id as inspectionId, inspection_no as inspectionNo, source, order_no as orderNo, coil_no as coilNo, material_code as materialCode, steel_grade as steelGrade, state, standard, thickness_val as thicknessVal, nominal_width as nominalWidth, width_val as widthVal, yield_val as yieldVal, tensile_val as tensileVal, elongation_val as elongationVal, hv_val as hvVal, surface_ra_val as surfaceRaVal, judge_result as judgeResult, judge_detail as judgeDetail, inspector, inspect_date as inspectDate, remark from qc_inspection where coil_no = #{coilNo} order by inspection_id

select s.shipment_id as shipmentId, s.shipment_no as shipmentNo, s.customer_name as customerName, s.order_no as orderNo, s.address as address, s.receiver as receiver, s.phone as phone, s.shipment_date as shipmentDate, s.total_weight as totalWeight, s.total_pieces as totalPieces, s.status as status, s.remark as remark from inv_shipment s inner join inv_shipment_item i on i.shipment_id = s.shipment_id where i.coil_no = #{coilNo} order by s.shipment_id
